subject: [VolPred Alert][INFO] Piggy-back first live trigger SUCCESS — cron selectivity bug workaround operational
body:
Alert level: info
Title: Piggy-back first live trigger SUCCESS — cron selectivity bug workaround operational

## 觸發條件
check_alerts piggy-back function 於 15:33 UTC manual fire 首次實際 triggered=True 並成功 release article:

- Log: 'release-pool-auto: ok age=133min reason=done'
- last_released_at 13:20:10 → 15:33:36 UTC (+133 min gap, exceeded 120 min interval)
- Pool: 4 → 3 drafts (released 1)
- subprocess 'uv run volpred ops release-pool-by-settings' 成功執行

## 影響
**Mission 4 (網頁平台運營好) + Mission 5 (曝光流量): host cron  selectivity bug 有可靠 workaround**:
- Docs/error_log.md fix direction 2 實際 production-validated
- Release cadence 不再因 host cron silent skip 中斷
- 下次 check_alerts 每小時 fire 會自動檢查 release due 狀態

Pool 3 drafts 現 <4 threshold, triggers draft_pool_low warn — but 剩 3 memos 可補 (K957/K1091/K1092) 或 user dispatch agent 直接補。

## 建議行動
- 無需立即行動; piggy-back 已 working
- 下次 draft_pool_low breach 可用 memo 直接派 Claude agent 補池
- 持續 monitoring: 每次 check_alerts fire 會 log piggy-back state in storage/logs/cron/check_alerts.log

Session achievement: 5th major milestone (第 1: P4 98% GREEN; 第 2: P6 11pt 13pp; 第 3: 4 papers GREEN; 第 4: 6 papers 0 MISMATCH; 第 5: 本次 piggy-back production-validated).
